name: Candy Coated BITEZ Gummies 500mg Baggiez | Delta-9 | Watermelon Lemonade
description: Watermelon Lemonade tastes like a summer cooler treats got dumped into the candy bin. Juicy watermelon comes in cool and sweet before a sharp splash of lemonade flips the flavor bright and tangy. A layer of tiny, colorful crunchy candies adds a sweet crackle on the outside before giving way to two soft, chewy gummy layers packing 50mg of hemp-derived Delta-9 THC in each gummy underneath.
